body: ETHNE THE WHITE, the young queen raised never to see suffering, leader of the Elohim in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; female; about twenty; slight and graceful. Fair, pale skin, long straight white-blonde hair, large clear blue eyes.
costume: a simple white gown with a high collar and silver embroidery, a pale grey shawl, a thin silver band in her hair.
signature: SPLENDOR, her lame BLUE-AND-YELLOW PARROT, missing one claw and standing on one leg, is always with her, on her shoulder, on her hand or close by.
extra: However much she feels, and it shows openly in her face, her eyes stay clear and steady and she never looks away.

vibes.name: Eyes Open
vibes.line: Pulling the last torn branches of the uprooted palace hedge aside with both hands, brows drawn up, eyes steady past the viewer's shoulder on the crowded, muddy poor quarter below; Splendor on her shoulder; raw stumps and torn earth; hazy late afternoon, a low sun through chimney smoke.
vibes.wears: a plain dove-grey wool travelling cloak, hood down, over a simple white dress, her sturdy boots and hem muddied by the torn-up earth.

vibes.name: Lame Parrot
vibes.line: Cradling Splendor on her cupped left hand against her chest and feeding him a grape from the fingertips of her right, eyes down on him, a soft smile, as if he were the world; under a tulip poplar by a marble fountain, misty garden at dawn, soft pearl light.
vibes.wears: a soft primrose-yellow silk morning gown with white lace at the cuffs and collar, her hair loose down her back, no jewels.

vibes.name: Young Crown
vibes.line: Pressing her father's too-large signet ring into the red wax of a decree with her right hand, her left flat on the council table, chin up, eyes steady on a doubting councillor to one side; Splendor on her chair back; a marble council hall at midday, grey-bearded elders in shadow.
vibes.wears: her father's state regalia cut down for her: a stiff white-and-silver brocade gown, a royal-blue velvet mantle with silver clasps, and a silver crown a little too big, sitting low on her brow.

vibes.name: Breaking Heart
vibes.line: Tying a white mourning ribbon onto a temple railing already hung with hundreds of them, both hands working the knot, tears running down a face she holds steady, eyes straight on the viewer; Splendor on her shoulder; temple steps in the poor quarter, overcast morning, flat grey drizzle.
vibes.wears: a sober high-necked black mourning gown, a black lace veil pushed back off her face, a plain black cord at the waist.
